reviews.author: 首尔上门服务Outcall&Incall
reviews.text: Overall, this restaurant was a satisfactory experience. The modern, minimalist atmosphere, soft lighting, and ample seating space make it perfect for gatherings with friends. The signature dish, braised pork belly, has a moderate amount of fat, but is not greasy and melts in your mouth, making it a fantastic combination when eaten with rice. Kung Pao Chicken is perfectly cooked and served with crunchy peanuts. The staff is friendly and the food comes out quickly in about 15 minutes even during peak hours. The price is reasonable at about 80 yuan per person and is good value for money. The downside is that there may be a waiting time on weekends, so it's best to make a reservation. The bathroom seems to need improvement. Overall, I recommend it, and I intend to visit again. We especially recommend the refreshing and delicious plum juice, which has the perfect balance of sweet and sour flavors. There is convenient parking in front of the restaurant. However, it is unfortunate that the amount is somewhat small. Those who eat a lot may need to order several menu items. Overall, it's a decent casual restaurant suitable for casual gatherings. If service details are improved, such as refilling the car more actively, it will be much more perfect.

reviews.author: 首尔外围Outcall&Incall
reviews.text: This restaurant is truly great value for money! The atmosphere is elegant and comfortable, boasting sophisticated interiors, ample seating space, and a fantastic dining atmosphere. The food is especially recommended. The signature dish, braised pork belly, is rich in flavor but not greasy and melts in your mouth. The steamed sea bass is soft and moist, and the seasoning is just right. The staff are friendly and polite, and the food is served quickly. There may be a waiting time during peak hours, but the restaurant's thoughtfulness in providing tea and light snacks is outstanding. The prices are much cheaper than other restaurants of similar standard, and the portions are generous. The only downside is that the dessert selection is limited, but the main dishes are so good that it's definitely worth a visit. Highly recommended for friends or family gatherings. This place lives up to its title as the best value restaurant, and I will definitely be visiting again!

reviews.author: TED NAM
reviews.text: Before going to Dokdo, I went to an experience center with my child. I didn't even know that there was an experience center like this in the middle of Seoul, but I found out about it while searching for Dokdo. A scale model of Dokdo is also on display, and if you register on site, you can hear detailed explanations from the guide, making it a great place for children's education. It was fun to read and I learned a lot about things I didn't know because they explained everything about the creation process of Dokdo and surrounding Ulleungdo, the natural ecosystem, and history. If you solve a few quizzes, you will receive a small souvenir, and while viewing the exhibition room, you can have your photo taken and printed in the Dokdo Newspaper. It seems like the best educational place for a child. It's close to Seoul Station, so it's easily accessible, and it's a place worth visiting with children.

I looked up the Internet in advance and went there, and the students' older sisters and brothers served as docents. That was impressive as well.
Although it is not large in scale, it was an opportunity to think about Dokdo once again with meaningful content.
There was also a group of foreign visitors, and it was cool to see them listening with serious expressions. I plan to visit again next time^^
If you listen carefully and answer the quiz about Dokdo, you will receive a gift. If you write a letter to the Dokdo Coast Guard and solve all the study materials provided, you will receive another gift.
When I think about Dokdo again with my child, I worked hard~

I went there with my kids during winter vacation and I was really satisfied.
It was nice to be able to enjoy it without worrying about fine dust or weather because it was an indoor zoo, and parking was easy because it was inside Starfield.
To be honest, I thought it would be small because it was indoors, but every time I opened the door, a new themed space appeared, so it was much more spacious than I expected.
The kids really liked it because they could see the animals up close and experience feeding them themselves.
There were a variety of programs at different times, so there was no time to get bored, and the interior was well decorated, so even as an adult, I had fun looking around.
It's a great place to go with children, and I'd also recommend it as a unique date course.
I want to visit again next time 👍

reviews.author: father and son
reviews.text:
If you want to truly feel the end-of-the-year atmosphere, I recommend this place!
This year too, there is a huge Christmas tree installed in the center of the lobby, and it is overwhelming when you see it in person. The lights are twinkling and the gold and red decorations are in harmony, making the photos look really pretty.

The shopping mall is large, so department stores, movie theaters, restaurants, and cafes are all located in one building. Parking is relatively spacious, and accessibility is good as it is connected to the subway. It's crowded on weekends, but the atmosphere makes it worth the wait.

There were many photo zones and it was perfect to take pictures while having a cup of coffee next to the tree.
